contract: An overlapping join is refused and recorded. The partitions stay with their original owner.
An undelivered partition is not committed. A delivered partition is committed. A stale generation stores nothing and leaves the committed offset in place.
After a cooperative revoke, another member can own the freed partition. A static instance replacement removes the old member id and does not duplicate ownership.
Reopen keeps the committed offsets and the disjoint assignment. Session expiry removes the silent member and keeps the offset that member had already committed.
limits: The history drives the local lifecycle and offset journals. It is not a JoinGroup, SyncGroup, Heartbeat, or OffsetCommit RPC trace against Apache Kafka.
Failed attempts recorded are overlap-join, undelivered-commit, stale-generation, and member-crash.
Not a production qualification and not a fastest-server claim.
